title: neopicrorhiza scrophulariiflora
intro: Neopicrorhiza scrophulariiflora, commonly known as Himalayan Picrorhiza, is a plant species that belongs to the family Picraeaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of digestive issues, fever, and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Neopicrorhiza scrophulariiflora include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing oxidative stress and promoting overall well-being.
